target: other (static HTML / CSS / JS, no build step)

brief.pitch: Upgrade of two-oaks-technologies.com (Huntsville, AL web/Google/social/apps partner). Dark forest green and gold. Their banner at the top, no vertical grid lines, particles flowing down the screen.

style.note: Laocoön type system (Italiana + Outfit) on the current site's palette: forest #08110D, cream #ECE7DA, gold #C4A574. Tokens in assets/css/styles.css :root (--gl-*, --stream-*).

palettes.cta-gradient: jade-depths → overridden in CONFIG to emerald + gold

sections.composition: house reveal choreography (design B: no counter)
sections.asset: the client's emblem.png rising out of the ground

sections.composition: full-bleed banner, copy split 8|4 at the base
ruled ledger on a frosted slab

sections.asset: generative SVG oaks (the two boys) grown on scroll, cross at the centre

rules: One WebGL scene above the fold (the stream)
Tint scenes via CONFIG / --stream-* tokens only — never the shader
Sections carry no opaque fills so the stream reads through
Gate flips at the start of the curtain exit

scene.note: Relay's stream-scene/stream-path/particle-stream lifted verbatim; only the waypoints (anchored to this page's section ids) and a small runtime shim are new. Keep waypoints in document order; renaming a section id straightens the stream.
